title: Recent Developments in Urban Studies; Zoning and Land Use Plan Implementation
description: An introduction to zoning and its relationship to land use planning, placing emphasis on the legal context that shapes zoning practice, particularly in the state of Maryland is provided. Additionally, addresses terminology, legal context, zoning ordinance interpretation, the role of various constituencies in the zoning process, and the relationship between the zoning ordinance and the comprehensive plan. It will also feature exercises and applied projects designed to convey course concepts through experiential learning.
